bookingTerms.heading: Before you pay
points: Sambramo connects you with independent masters. They perform the service; we arrange it, hold the payment and stand behind it.
Your money is held until 24 hours after your event. The master is paid once it is done and you have had a chance to raise anything.
The price shown is what is charged. No fee, tax or charge is added later.
Where the setup is agreed on a call, the price covers the standard setup described. Anything beyond it is agreed with you before work starts.
Cancel before a master accepts and you get everything back. After that, part goes to the master — not to us — because they cleared their day.
Something wrong? Raise it within 24 hours and the payment stays held until it is settled.
bookingTerms.confirm: I have read and agree to the booking terms.

tax.note: TCS and TDS are collected on the partner’s behalf and deposited with the authorities. They are not Sambramo’s income and are shown as separate lines on every earnings statement.

darkPatterns.risk: The 45-second offer countdown, and any "3 masters left" copy on the matching screen.
darkPatterns.rule: The countdown must be the real dispatch_offers.expires_at. A scarcity count must be a real COUNT(*), never a decorative number.

darkPatterns.risk: Adding a service the customer did not tap.
darkPatterns.rule: Nothing enters booking_lines without an explicit tap. No pre-ticked extras.
State the deduction and the reason. Never "are you sure you want to disappoint them?"

darkPatterns.risk: Requiring signup to see a price.
darkPatterns.rule: The quote is visible before auth. Sign-in is asked at payment, as the shop already does.
Cancelling must be as easy as signing up: in-app, no phone call.

darkPatterns.risk: Making "Pay for 3 now" visually dominant over "keep looking".
darkPatterns.rule: Equal visual weight. Partial fill is not a failure state and must not be styled as one.

darkPatterns.risk: The `discuss` services — advertising a price for "standard setup" and delivering less.
darkPatterns.rule: The standard setup must be specified concretely enough to be checked against. This is the highest-risk pattern in this product.

darkPatterns.risk: Revealing the platform fee, GST or any charge only at checkout.
darkPatterns.rule: The number on the matching screen is the number charged. No line appears later.
If a partner ever pays for placement it must be labelled. Today match_partners() orders by distance and rating only — that is a promise.

darkPatterns.risk: Repeat push to finish a booking.
darkPatterns.rule: At most one reminder per abandoned basket.

darkPatterns.risk: Wording the cancellation deduction as a "service adjustment".
darkPatterns.rule: Call it what it is: money that goes to your master.

darkPatterns.risk: Not applicable — no recurring consumer billing.
darkPatterns.rule: Re-audit if a customer membership ships.

complianceGaps: Terms have not been reviewed by counsel
GSTIN not set — required before collecting TCS
